links.comparator_used: Guideline-RAG given overlapping source documents as raw text (plus a baseline arm using the same synthesis model)
links.outcome: Evidence verifiability of citations; clinical feature coverage; clinician-rated safety and completeness
links.effect: HEG-TKG: 100% evidence verifiability with 203 inline citations vs zero verifiable citations for Guideline-RAG; clinical feature coverage matched baseline; clinician-rated verifiability advantage Cohen's d = 1.81, p < 0.001, with no degradation on safety or completeness
links.quote: Guideline-RAG, given overlapping source documents as raw text, produces zero verifiable citations.
